name: Fog Cloud
description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st. (Modelled: the heavy-obscured zone and upcast_size_ft; wind dispersal is not expressible. Obscurement's combat effect waits on vision/lighting.)
